name: Sirio Pharma Co., Ltd.
summary: Sirio Pharma Co., Ltd. operates as a contract manufacturer for dietary supplement industry China, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company develops and manufactures a range of softgel dietary supplements; vegetarian softgel; nutritious gummies; liquids; probiotic balls; tablet and powder products; capsules; and functional beverages for beauty and wellness, gut health, bone and joint health, immune and fertility support, cardiovascular and metabolic health, and healthy ageing. It also offers formulation; technical, and research and development support; and primary and final packaging services. Sirio Pharma Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Shantou, China…
